question: Will a global dormant-memory correction policy abstain appropriately when multiple simultaneously observed live overlaps provide conflicting evidence of the target shift?
hypothesis: A unanimity gate should decline all ambiguous heterogeneous correction signals, unlike a plurality/tie-break strategy that may update dormant associations despite no universally supported delta.
new_schedule: For seed s and episode e, seven consecutive active motif IDs [(s+3*e+j)%16 for j0..6], so consecutive episodes overlap exactly four motifs, always two even and two odd. This geometry change is frozen and disjoint from earlier keyed-seven patterns. Maximum dormant storage remains nine of sixteen keys.
targets: Initial target SHA256('Y033/'+seed+'/'+key) first byte modulo4. STABLE unchanged; MIXED_SWITCH at episode6 uses +1 for even-key motifs and +2 for odd-key motifs. Predictor sees only observed current labels after making all seven predictions.
arms: baseline: regular observed live/dormant cache with no correction
consensus: if live-overlap cues all show the same nonzero modular target delta, update every currently dormant value by that delta; otherwise abstain
plurality: among nonzero observed live-overlap deltas choose the most frequent, breaking ties toward smaller delta, and apply it globally to dormant memory (report any resulting unsupported updates)
primary: Record overlap count, per-episode observed delta histogram, 12-episode correct and post-switch episode7..11 correct, stale dormant-return predictions, correction events, maintenance value writes, capacity/write parity, and disagreement/abstention events.
classification: CONSENSUS_ABSTAINS if each heldout seed at switch has both +1/+2 feedback, consensus makes zero heterogeneous correction updates while plurality makes >0; HARMFUL_PLURALITY if plurality post-switch score < consensus; OTHER outcome otherwise. Both science- and efficiency-related claims must report exact scores, not just policy status.
controls: Same seven current + <=nine dormant entries, same input feedback, exact cache eviction sequence. Label function evaluator-only after predictions. Verify four-overlap with two-even/two-odd at every transition, eight unique seed/event signatures, no future labels/hidden oracle.
claim_limit: Tiny synthetic consensus abstention policy, not independent evidence of general scientific decision-making or semantic learning.
